'''M4-Y9''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] active around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M4-Y9 was a gift given to all players through their mailbox in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' as a gift for Star Wars Day on [[May 4]], [[2020]]. "M4-Y9" stands for May 4 of Year 9.<ref name="TOR" />
